name: Self-evolving structure
principle: The structure notices where it falls short and improves itself at the moment a change makes it worse.
state_description: An agent who has never read the rules sees each finding as it happens, with the rule, the path and the next step, and rules that stop catching anything fall away.
hints_of_measurement: The share of injected violations reported by the right rule and path, the share of clean trees never flagged, and how many rules caught nothing over a month.
